title: Efficient Agent Training for Computer Use
authors_zh: Yanheng He, Jiahe Jin, Pengfei Liu
paper_type_zh: 计算机使用智能体数据发布与构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究 GUI agent 轨迹构造、多模态 SFT、环境反馈契约与合成动作审计的读者
one_line: PC Agent-E turns 312 human Windows demonstrations into action-level screenshot-history-to-thought/action SFT data, but its Claude-generated branch actions are never environment-validated.
PC Agent-E 将 312 条人工 Windows 完整轨迹扩展为 action-level 多模态 SFT 数据，但每步九个 Claude 分支均未执行，也没有经过环境成功验证。
why: It is a compact, released example of trajectory-to-SFT construction whose gains can be tied to a concrete data object, while clearly showing why synthetic agent actions should not be mistaken for verified environment episodes.
inclusion_reason: The work releases a rare inspectable computer-use data recipe in which 312 human Windows episodes are expanded into action-level multimodal SFT targets, while also exposing a crucial audit boundary: the nine Claude alternatives per step are not executed or environment-verified.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources are the current arXiv v2 paper, the accepted OpenReview text, and the official ICLR 2026 poster record; the paper first appeared in 2025 and is formally published as an ICLR 2026 conference paper. The Card also relies on the author-maintained PC-Agent-E repository, project page, Hugging Face dataset and model, and the WindowsAgentArena-V2 repository. These sources establish the paper identity, release boundary, code behavior, and evaluation surface rather than merely repeating the abstract.

The concrete problem is how to obtain useful computer-use supervision without collecting thousands of full human demonstrations. The paper begins with 312 retained human-completed Windows task trajectories, augments each human action with a reconstructed thought and nine alternative Claude 3.7 Sonnet thought-action decisions, and flattens the augmented episodes into approximately 27K action-level SFT samples. A released episode contains a companion task description plus per-step screenshot, normalized action, optional element and rectangle, marked screenshot, synthetic thought, and up to nine boost responses. The release contains 312 JSONL episodes, 312 task Markdown files, and 4,503 PNG screenshots; 4,503 images and 27K derived SFT rows must not be described as independent complete trajectories.

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because it exposes the conversion from executed GUI episodes into state-action supervision and because WindowsAgentArena-V2 supplies the environment-side evaluation contract. The boundary is equally important: the nine Claude alternatives are not executed branches, carry no post-action observation or environment reward, and therefore are not replayable trajectories. The work does not report RL, an online data-collection policy, or a training-time environmental verifier.

The Card is L4-ready at the content level because official paper, venue, code, data, model, construction scripts, training config, benchmark repository, and license surfaces were inspected. L4 does not mean the release is safe for unrestricted training reuse: screenshot privacy and rights, per-record lineage, replay-based correctness, synthetic-branch validity, and immutable versioning remain unresolved.

本卡的主要来源是当前 arXiv v2 论文、OpenReview 接收稿和 ICLR 2026 官方 poster 条目；论文最初发表于 2025 年，并已正式作为 ICLR 2026 conference paper 发表。本卡还核查了作者维护的 PC-Agent-E 代码仓库、项目页、Hugging Face 数据集与模型，以及 WindowsAgentArena-V2 仓库。这些来源用于确认论文身份、发布边界、代码行为与评测面，而不是简单改写摘要。

论文解决的具体问题是：如何在不收集数千条完整人工示范的前提下获得有效的计算机使用监督。方法从 312 条保留下来的人工完整 Windows 任务轨迹出发，为每个人工动作补全一段 thought，并生成九个 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 候选 thought-action 决策，最后将增强后的 episode 展平为约 27K 条 action-level SFT 样本。一个发布 episode 由配套任务描述和逐步字段组成，包括 screenshot、规范化 action、可选 element 与 rectangle、marked screenshot、合成 thought，以及最多九个 boost response。发布包包含 312 个 JSONL episode、312 个任务 Markdown 文件和 4,503 张 PNG screenshot；不能把 4,503 张图像或 27K 条派生 SFT 行写成彼此独立的完整轨迹。

它属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为论文公开了从已执行 GUI episode 到 state-action 监督的转换过程，WindowsAgentArena-V2 又提供了环境侧评测契约。边界同样关键：九个 Claude 替代动作不是已执行分支，没有动作后的 observation 或环境 reward，因此不能视为可 replay 的轨迹。论文也没有报告 RL、在线数据采集策略或训练时环境 verifier。

在内容层面，本卡已达到 L4-ready：已检查正式论文与会议信息、代码、数据、模型、构造脚本、训练配置、benchmark 仓库和许可证页面。但 L4 不表示数据可不受限制地用于训练；screenshot 隐私与权利、逐记录 lineage、基于 replay 的正确性、合成分支有效性和不可变版本仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a trajectory-to-SFT recipe: retain a small human-executed main trunk, ask Claude 3.7 Sonnet to supply missing rationales and nine single-step alternatives at every human state, and train a native screenshot-based agent on the union of human and synthetic thought-action targets.

The core data object has two levels. At episode level, a human task is represented by a task description and a sequence of screenshots and executed keyboard or mouse actions. At training level, each human or synthetic node becomes an independent sample whose input is the current 1280x720 screenshot, task description, and textual history of prior human-trunk thoughts and actions, and whose target is one ReAct-style thought plus one normalized action. Synthetic nodes share the human state and history but do not create a new environment transition; previous screenshots are also excluded from context.

The feedback contract is mixed but must be split by stage. For released and training traces, finish and fail are terminal action tokens; failed-ending records are removed, and the cleaning code can rewrite the final surviving action to finish. This records a construction decision, not independent proof that the Windows task succeeded. Ordinary Claude alternatives receive only syntax and placeholder filtering and are never executed. During evaluation, WindowsAgentArena-V2 separately restores virtual-machine snapshots and applies task-specific evaluators to the resulting application state, with some LLM-based initialization checks and limited human evaluation. The agent's finish stops interaction, whereas the benchmark evaluator decides success.

The closest internal comparison is direct distillation from Claude: ten executed end-to-end Claude trajectories per task, 3,120 trajectories total, trained with the same procedure. PC Agent-E instead samples alternatives only at human-visited states, avoiding synthetic branch continuation and its accumulated errors. Human-only thought completion is another baseline. Relative to broad computer-use datasets that collect or simulate full episodes, this work changes the supervision interface to multiple positive action targets per trusted human state; it does not make those targets environment-verified. That distinction is the main direction signal for the assigned track.

本文的贡献是一套 trajectory-to-SFT 配方：保留小规模人工执行主干，让 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 在每个人工状态补全缺失 rationale，并生成九个单步替代决策，再用人工与合成 thought-action target 的并集训练原生 screenshot-based agent。

核心数据对象分为两层。episode 层面，一项人工任务由任务描述以及 screenshot 与已执行键鼠 action 的序列构成。训练层面，每个人工或合成节点被转换成独立样本：输入是当前 1280×720 screenshot、任务描述和此前人工主干 thought/action 的文本历史，target 是一段 ReAct-style thought 加一个规范化 action。合成节点共享人工状态和历史，但不会产生新的环境 transition；上下文也不包含过去的 screenshot。

反馈契约是 mixed，但必须按阶段拆开。对发布与训练 trace 而言，finish 和 fail 是终止 action token；以失败结束的记录会被删除，清洗代码还可能把最后保留的 action 重写为 finish。这反映的是构造规则，不是 Windows 任务成功的独立证明。普通 Claude 替代动作只经过语法和 placeholder 过滤，从未在环境中执行。评测时，WindowsAgentArena-V2 另行恢复虚拟机 snapshot，并由任务特定 evaluator 检查最终应用状态，其中包含部分基于 LLM 的初始化检查和少量人工评测。agent 的 finish 只负责停止交互，benchmark evaluator 才负责判定成功。

最接近的内部对照是 Claude direct distillation：每项任务执行十条 Claude end-to-end 轨迹，共 3,120 条，并采用相同训练流程。PC Agent-E 只在人工访问过的状态采样替代动作，从而不继续展开合成分支，也避免分支误差逐步累积。仅做人工轨迹 thought completion 是另一个 baseline。相较于收集或模拟完整 episode 的一般 computer-use 数据，本文把监督接口改成每个可信人工状态对应多个正向 action target；但这些 target 并未得到环境验证。这一区分正是本 track 最重要的方向信号。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and human collection. A manually composed set of tasks spanning Windows applications is enlarged by undisclosed LLMs. Two annotators execute tasks on their own Windows computers while PC Tracker records screen observations and keyboard or mouse actions. Annotators may discard unsatisfactory runs or revise task descriptions. The retained set has 312 complete trajectories: 74 with 2–5 steps, 139 with 6–10, 73 with 11–15, and 26 with 16–30. Rule cleaning removes failed-ending and null-action records plus redundant or meaningless actions, resizes coordinates and screenshots to 1280×720, and ensures the last surviving step is finish.

Contamination filtering. Each retained task must have zero 13-gram overlap, 3-gram overlap below 0.7, and cosine semantic similarity below 0.85 against every WindowsAgentArena-V2 test task. The thresholds are disclosed, but the semantic encoder, task-expansion model and prompts, and decontamination implementation are unknown.

Thought completion and Trajectory Boost. The released code uses claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219. Given the task, current screenshot, current human action, and up to 30 prior human-trunk thought/action entries, Claude reconstructs the thought for the human action. It then samples nine separate alternative thought-action responses per human step with max_tokens=1000 and 18 concurrent workers. Temperature and top-p are not set in the code and remain unknown. Alternatives are not executed. Filtering removes null or unparseable responses and literal (x, y) placeholders; on a human finish node, a synthetic response must also contain finish. No ordinary synthetic action is checked by an environment transition, reward, or semantic correctness verifier.

Flattening and outputs. prepare.py converts every human and retained synthetic node into a separate LLaMA-Factory sample. The input contains one current screenshot, the task, and prior human-trunk textual history; the target is a thought plus one action from the unified vocabulary: click, right click, double click, drag, scroll, press key, hotkey, type text, wait, finish, or fail. The result is about 27K action-level samples derived from 312 augmented episodes. The public 1.57 GB data.zip is the episode package—312 JSONL files, 312 companion task files, and 4,503 PNG screenshots—not a ready-made 27K JSON and not a replay bundle with VM snapshots, post-action observations, rewards, or evaluator outputs.

Training and evaluation. Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct is full-parameter fine-tuned in LLaMA-Factory with the visual tower frozen, 8192-token cutoff, batch size 128, learning rate 2e-6, cosine schedule, warmup ratio 0.05, two epochs, and 32 GPUs; the paper reports about five hours, while GPU model and a pinned container are unknown. Evaluation uses a screenshot-only PC Agent-E scaffold at 1280×720. WindowsAgentArena-V2 has 141 feasible tasks across 11 Windows applications, restores VM snapshots, and judges success using task-specific evaluators after interaction; agents terminate by finish, fail, or a default 30-step cap. OSWorld supplies a separate Linux transfer evaluation.

For reproduction, pin the repository commit, LLaMA-Factory submodule commit f96c0858574c4d465301b2446b59c808326b10fd, Qwen base, Claude snapshot, Hugging Face model and data blobs, benchmark task/evaluator revision, VM images, screen resolution, step budget, and action parser. Also preserve raw Claude responses, rejected responses, human task files, and cleaning logs; these are necessary to distinguish generated candidates from executed episodes and to audit selection losses.

输入与人工采集。 研究者先人工编写覆盖多种 Windows 应用的任务集合，再用未披露的 LLM 扩大任务池。两名标注者在各自 Windows 电脑上执行任务，PC Tracker 记录屏幕 observation 和键鼠 action。标注者可以丢弃不满意的运行或修改任务描述。最终保留 312 条完整轨迹：74 条含 2–5 步、139 条含 6–10 步、73 条含 11–15 步、26 条含 16–30 步。规则清洗删除以失败结束和 action 为空的记录，以及冗余或无意义 action，将坐标与 screenshot 缩放到 1280×720，并保证最后保留步骤为 finish。

污染过滤。 每项保留任务与 WindowsAgentArena-V2 的每项测试任务都必须满足：13-gram overlap 为 0、3-gram overlap 低于 0.7、语义 cosine similarity 低于 0.85。阈值已经披露，但语义 encoder、扩充任务的模型与 prompt，以及 decontamination 实现均为 unknown。

Thought completion 与 Trajectory Boost。 发布代码使用 claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219。Claude 根据任务、当前 screenshot、当前人工 action，以及最多 30 条此前人工主干 thought/action 记录，为人工 action 重建 thought。随后，它为每个人工步骤分别采样九个替代 thought-action response，设置 max_tokens=1000 并使用 18 个并发 worker。代码没有设置 temperature 或 top-p，因此两者为 unknown。替代动作不会在环境中执行。过滤会删除空响应、无法解析的响应和字面 (x, y) placeholder；若人工节点为 finish，合成响应也必须包含 finish。普通合成 action 不经过环境 transition、reward 或语义正确性 verifier。

展平与输出。 prepare.py 把每个人工节点和保留的合成节点转换成独立 LLaMA-Factory 样本。输入包含一张当前 screenshot、任务和此前人工主干的文本历史；target 是 thought 加一个统一词表 action，包括 click、right click、double click、drag、scroll、press key、hotkey、type text、wait、finish 或 fail。最终从 312 条增强 episode 派生约 27K 条 action-level 样本。公开的 1.57 GB data.zip 是 episode 包，包含 312 个 JSONL、312 个配套任务文件和 4,503 张 PNG screenshot；它不是现成的 27K JSON，也不是带 VM snapshot、动作后 observation、reward 或 evaluator 输出的 replay bundle。

训练与评测。 Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct 在 LLaMA-Factory 中进行 full-parameter SFT，冻结 visual tower，cutoff 为 8192，batch size 为 128，learning rate 为 2e-6，使用 cosine schedule、0.05 warmup ratio、2 个 epoch 和 32 块 GPU；论文报告约 5 小时，但 GPU 型号和固定 container 为 unknown。评测使用 1280×720、仅输入 screenshot 的 PC Agent-E scaffold。WindowsAgentArena-V2 包含 11 个 Windows 应用中的 141 项可行任务，会恢复 VM snapshot，并在交互结束后用任务特定 evaluator 判定成功；agent 通过 finish、fail 或默认 30-step cap 终止。OSWorld 提供独立的 Linux transfer 评测。

复现时应固定代码仓库 commit、LLaMA-Factory submodule commit f96c0858574c4d465301b2446b59c808326b10fd、Qwen 基座、Claude snapshot、Hugging Face 模型与数据 blob、benchmark 任务和 evaluator 版本、VM image、屏幕分辨率、step budget 与 action parser。还应保留原始 Claude response、拒绝记录、人工任务文件和清洗日志；这些材料是区分生成候选与已执行 episode、审计 selection loss 的必要条件。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The following are author-reported results under their stated settings; no independent reproduction is reported. Success rate is the WindowsAgentArena-V2 environment evaluator's task-level success rate, not the fraction of training samples judged correct.

| Comparison | Model/data condition | Benchmark and budget | Reported result | What the result supports—and does not support | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Base vs PC Agent-E | Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct base vs the same base after full SFT on about 27K action-level samples from 312 augmented human episodes | WindowsAgentArena-V2, 141 feasible tasks across 11 Windows apps, screenshot-only 1280×720 scaffold, default 30-step cap | 14.9 → 36.0 success rate; (36.0-14.9)/14.9 ≈ 141.6% relative | Supports the headline “141%” only relative to this Qwen base under these conditions. It is not a 141% gain over Claude and does not certify data quality row by row. | | Human-only vs Trajectory Boost | Thought-completed human trajectories vs adding nine unexecuted synthetic alternatives per human step | Same training and WindowsAgentArena-V2 evaluation family | 17.2 vs 36.0 | Supports an incremental benefit from the synthetic alternatives in the reported pipeline; it does not show that each alternative is executable or correct. | | Direct distillation vs PC Agent-E | Ten executed Claude end-to-end trajectories per task, 3,120 total, trained with the same procedure vs alternatives sampled at human states | WindowsAgentArena-V2, reported comparison in Figure 7 | 26.2 vs 36.0 | Supports the paper's data-construction comparison. The explanation that avoiding accumulated errors causes the gap remains an author interpretation. | | Proprietary baselines | Claude 3.7 Sonnet without extended thinking; Claude 3.7 Sonnet with extended thinking | Same 141-task benchmark table and agent setting | 32.6 and 35.4 vs PC Agent-E 36.0 | The gain over non-thinking Claude is about 10% relative; the margin over extended-thinking Claude is only 0.6 percentage points. | | Longer horizon | PC Agent-E with 30 vs 50 maximum steps | WindowsAgentArena-V2, Appendix E, Table 8 | 36.0 at 30 steps vs 31.4 at 50 | Negative evidence: more interaction budget harms performance because agents may continue after completion and undo correct state. | | Cross-platform transfer | Qwen base vs PC Agent-E, both with 30 steps | OSWorld, which includes infeasible tasks | 11.1 → 14.9, about 34% relative | Shows reported transfer beyond Windows training; the paper itself warns that infeasible tasks can reward indiscriminate fail behavior. |

The paper also reports about three hours for offline Trajectory Boost versus about 900 hours for an equivalent 3,120-trajectory direct-distillation collection, described as 300×. Hardware details and accounting methodology are undisclosed, so this is a synthesis-time claim rather than a portable cost estimate. WindowsAgentArena-V2 repairs infeasible tasks, evaluator bugs, and initialization behavior; the authors report initialization failures falling from 10–30% to below 5%. These benchmark repairs improve the evaluation surface but remain separate from correctness verification of the released SFT targets.

下表均为作者在特定设置下报告的结果，尚无独立复现。success rate 是 WindowsAgentArena-V2 环境 evaluator 给出的任务级成功率，不是训练样本被判定正确的比例。

| 对比 | 模型/数据条件 | Benchmark 与预算 | 报告结果 | 结果能够支持什么、不能支持什么 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 基座 vs PC Agent-E | Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct 基座，与同一基座在 312 条增强人工 episode 派生的约 27K 条 action-level 样本上做 full SFT | WindowsAgentArena-V2，11 个 Windows 应用、141 项可行任务，仅 screenshot 的 1280×720 scaffold，默认 30-step cap | success rate 14.9 → 36.0；(36.0-14.9)/14.9 ≈ 141.6% relative | “141%”只适用于相对该 Qwen 基座和这些条件。它不是相对 Claude 的 141% 提升，也不能逐条认证数据质量。 | | 仅人工数据 vs Trajectory Boost | 做 thought completion 的人工轨迹，与每个人工步骤再加入九个未执行合成替代动作 | 相同训练与 WindowsAgentArena-V2 评测体系 | 17.2 vs 36.0 | 支持合成替代动作在所报告 pipeline 中带来增量价值，但不能证明每个替代动作可执行或正确。 | | Direct distillation vs PC Agent-E | 每项任务十条已执行 Claude end-to-end 轨迹，共 3,120 条，使用同一训练流程；对比只在人工状态采样替代动作 | WindowsAgentArena-V2，Figure 7 的报告对比 | 26.2 vs 36.0 | 支持论文的数据构造对比；“避免累积错误造成差距”仍是作者解释。 | | 闭源基线 | Claude 3.7 Sonnet without extended thinking；Claude 3.7 Sonnet with extended thinking | 同一 141-task benchmark 表与 agent 设置 | 32.6 和 35.4，PC Agent-E 为 36.0 | 相对 non-thinking Claude 的提升约为 10%；相对 extended-thinking Claude 仅高 0.6 个百分点。 | | 更长 horizon | PC Agent-E 的最大 30 步与 50 步 | WindowsAgentArena-V2，Appendix E，Table 8 | 30 步为 36.0，50 步为 31.4 | 这是负面证据：更高交互预算反而降低性能，因为 agent 可能在完成后继续操作并破坏正确状态。 | | 跨平台 transfer | Qwen 基座与 PC Agent-E，均为 30 步 | OSWorld，其中包含不可行任务 | 11.1 → 14.9，约 34% relative | 表明作者报告了 Windows 训练之外的 transfer；论文同时警告不可行任务可能奖励无差别 fail 行为。 |

论文还报告离线 Trajectory Boost 约需 3 小时，而等量 3,120 条 direct-distillation 轨迹的采集约需 900 小时，并称为 300×。由于硬件细节和计时方法未披露，这只是 synthesis-time claim，不是可迁移的成本估计。WindowsAgentArena-V2 修复了不可行任务、evaluator bug 和初始化行为；作者报告初始化失败率从 10–30% 降至 5% 以下。这些修复改善了评测面，但与发布 SFT target 的正确性验证仍是两件事。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is full-trajectory collection or distillation: obtain complete computer-use demonstrations from humans or a strong proprietary model and train on those episodes. The paper's own direct-distillation comparator executes ten complete Claude trajectories for each task. A second baseline retains only the 312 human trajectories after adding synthetic thoughts.

PC Agent-E changes the unit of synthetic expansion. Rather than allowing Claude to choose an action and then continue from its own potentially erroneous state, Trajectory Boost queries nine alternative one-step decisions at every state on the executed human trunk. The resulting supervision object is therefore a fan of thought-action targets around a trusted screenshot and history, not a tree of observed transitions. Flattening both human and branch nodes into action-level multimodal SFT rows is the consequential training-use change.

Several components are integrations rather than new primitives: human GUI recording, ReAct-style thought/action formatting, Claude generation, PyAutoGUI actions, Qwen2.5-VL, LLaMA-Factory SFT, VM-based GUI benchmarks, and task-specific evaluators all predate the work. The scale increase from 312 episodes to about 27K rows is likewise a consequence of repeated branching and flattening; it is not evidence of 27K independent tasks or executed episodes.

The direction signal for reasoning-data research is the deliberate trade: synthetic coverage grows cheaply by attaching multiple labels to a human state, while transition validity and terminal success are sacrificed for those branches. This creates a clean audit question for agent data—whether diversity at a fixed state can substitute for replay-verified trajectories. Before reuse, researchers should measure branch executability, semantic correctness, action diversity, hidden teacher style, human-state coverage, dropped-failure bias, and downstream sensitivity to removing invalid alternatives.

既有 baseline 是完整轨迹采集或蒸馏：由人类或强闭源模型完成整项计算机使用任务，再用这些 episode 训练。论文自己的 direct-distillation 对照会让 Claude 为每项任务执行十条完整轨迹。另一个 baseline 只保留 312 条人工轨迹，并为其补充合成 thought。

PC Agent-E 改变了合成扩展的基本单位。Trajectory Boost 不让 Claude 选择 action 后继续在自身可能出错的状态上运行，而是在已执行人工主干的每个状态查询九个替代单步决策。因此，新的监督对象是围绕一个可信 screenshot 与历史展开的一组 thought-action target，而不是包含真实 observation transition 的搜索树。随后把人工节点和分支节点都展平为 action-level 多模态 SFT 行，这才是对训练用法最关键的改变。

若干部件属于整合而不是新的基本机制：人工 GUI 录制、ReAct-style thought/action 格式、Claude 生成、PyAutoGUI action、Qwen2.5-VL、LLaMA-Factory SFT、基于 VM 的 GUI benchmark 和任务特定 evaluator 都早于本文。由 312 条 episode 扩展到约 27K 行同样是重复分支与展平的结果，并不表示存在 27K 项独立任务或已执行 episode。

它对 reasoning data 研究的方向意义来自一项明确取舍：在同一人工状态附加多个标签可以低成本扩大合成覆盖，但这些分支没有 transition validity 与终止成功证明。这为 agent 数据提出一个清晰审计问题——固定状态上的多样性，能否替代经过 replay 验证的轨迹。复用前应测量分支可执行性、语义正确性、action 多样性、隐藏 teacher 风格、人工状态覆盖、丢弃失败导致的偏差，以及删除无效替代动作后下游结果的敏感性。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Training feedback is not environmental. Nine Claude alternatives per human step are never executed and receive no next observation, task evaluator result, or reward. Syntax-valid responses can still click the wrong control, use a stale coordinate, or contradict hidden application state. Treating all retained branches as positive SFT targets can create false positives; this is a curator inference from the released pipeline.
  • Termination labels are construction-contaminated. Failed-ending records are removed, and refinement.py can rewrite the final surviving action to finish. finish is therefore partly a terminal token imposed by cleaning, not evidence that the environment goal was achieved. The 50-step decline from 36.0 to 31.4 also shows that termination awareness remains brittle.
  • Failure supervision is selectively absent. Failed human endings are dropped, ordinary failed attempts are not retained as labeled negatives, and synthetic branches have no success/failure label. This can bias the model toward plausible positive actions and hide recovery behavior; the downstream effect is not quantified.
  • Collection and lineage are incomplete. The LLMs, prompts, seed count, and mixture weights used to expand the task pool are unknown. Per-record task ancestry, Claude temperature/top-p, random seeds, rejection rates, cost, and the semantic-similarity encoder used for decontamination are also undisclosed.
  • Release reproducibility is partial. The dataset is one ZIP and the GitHub repository has no tagged release, immutable manifest, or changelog. GPU model, pinned runtime/container, VM images, raw evaluation logs, and evaluator revision used for reported scores are not bundled. Coordinate-based GUI actions are sensitive to resolution, scaling, application version, and initialization drift.
  • Rights and privacy remain unresolved. Repository, dataset-card, and model-card metadata state MIT, but annotator consent, screenshot redaction, PII review, application-asset rights, and third-party benchmark licenses are unknown. The MIT label alone does not establish that all visible desktop content can be redistributed or used for training.
  • Evaluation does not certify the data. WindowsAgentArena-V2 uses mixed hand-written, programmatic, LLM-assisted, and limited human checks and has required repairs for infeasible tasks and evaluator bugs. Benchmark gains can coexist with invalid training branches, evaluator false positives/negatives, or task-distribution overfitting. OSWorld's infeasible-task behavior further limits cross-platform interpretation.

• 训练反馈不是环境反馈。 每个人工步骤的九个 Claude 替代动作从未执行，也没有 next observation、任务 evaluator 结果或 reward。语法正确的 response 仍可能点击错误控件、使用失效坐标或与隐藏应用状态冲突。把所有保留分支都当作正向 SFT target 可能产生 false positive；这是根据发布 pipeline 得出的 curator inference。
  • 终止标签受到构造规则影响。 以失败结束的记录被删除，refinement.py 还可能把最后保留的 action 重写为 finish。因此，finish 部分是清洗阶段施加的终止 token，不是环境目标已经实现的证据。50 步设置下 success rate 从 36.0 降到 31.4，也表明 termination awareness 仍不稳健。
  • 失败监督被选择性移除。 失败的人工结尾被丢弃，普通失败尝试没有作为带标签负例保留，合成分支也没有成功/失败标签。这可能让模型偏向外观合理的正向 action，并隐藏恢复行为；论文没有量化其下游影响。
  • 采集与 lineage 不完整。 用于扩大任务池的 LLM、prompt、seed 数量和 mixture weight 为 unknown。逐记录任务来源、Claude temperature/top-p、random seed、拒绝率、成本，以及 decontamination 所用语义相似度 encoder 也未披露。
  • 发布复现性不完整。 数据集只有一个 ZIP，GitHub 仓库没有 tagged release、不可变 manifest 或 changelog。报告分数所用 GPU 型号、固定 runtime/container、VM image、原始评测日志和 evaluator 版本没有打包。基于坐标的 GUI action 对分辨率、缩放、应用版本与初始化漂移敏感。
  • 权利与隐私尚未解决。 代码仓库、dataset card 与 model card 的 metadata 标为 MIT，但标注者 consent、screenshot 脱敏、PII 检查、应用素材权利和第三方 benchmark 许可证均为 unknown。MIT 标签本身不能证明所有可见桌面内容都可再分发或用于训练。
  • 评测不能认证数据。 WindowsAgentArena-V2 混合使用手写、程序化、LLM-assisted 与少量人工检查，并曾修复不可行任务和 evaluator bug。benchmark 提升可以与无效训练分支、evaluator false positive/false negative 或任务分布过拟合同时存在。OSWorld 的不可行任务行为也限制了跨平台结论。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the environment_agent_trajectory_data track, the strongest use is as a construction and audit reference for turning a small set of executed GUI episodes into multimodal state-action supervision. Builders can reproduce three separable modules: human main-trunk capture, offline thought/action branching at recorded states, and flattening into screenshot-history-to-action SFT rows. An informative ablation should compare human-only targets, unverified branches, branches replayed through the environment, and branches filtered by the task evaluator while holding the base model and sample count fixed.

The release also supports schema and provenance studies. A reusable record should preserve task text, screenshot, action vocabulary and parser version, optional GUI element/rectangle, marked screenshot, synthetic thought, every raw boost response, rejection reason, human-trunk position, application and screen configuration, and whether the action was executed. finish should be recorded separately from evaluator success, and failed endings should be retained in an audit partition instead of silently disappearing.

For benchmark work, WindowsAgentArena-V2 is an evaluation surface rather than the training verifier. Researchers can study VM reset reliability, task feasibility, evaluator false positives and false negatives, fail hacking, and step-cap sensitivity. The 30-to-50-step regression is a concrete termination test, while OSWorld can probe distribution shift only if infeasible-task handling is reported separately.

Reuse class: the paper and code are suitable for reading, audit, and controlled reproduction; the released data are blocked pending verification for unrestricted training reuse because screenshot rights/privacy, per-record lineage, synthetic-action correctness, and immutable versioning are unresolved. Evaluation reuse should pin the benchmark commit, VM/application versions, task/evaluator files, resolution, and step cap. The reported benchmark improvement motivates these experiments but is not evidence that the underlying data are uniformly high quality.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data track 而言，最有价值的用途是把它作为构造与审计参考，研究如何将少量已执行 GUI episode 转换成多模态 state-action 监督。构建者可以分别复现三个模块：人工主干采集、在已记录状态上离线生成 thought/action 分支，以及展平为 screenshot-history-to-action SFT 行。一个有信息量的 ablation 应在保持基座模型和样本数不变时，对比仅人工 target、未验证分支、通过环境 replay 的分支，以及由任务 evaluator 过滤的分支。

该发布也适合研究 schema 与 provenance。可复用记录应保留任务文本、screenshot、action 词表与 parser 版本、可选 GUI element/rectangle、marked screenshot、合成 thought、每个原始 boost response、拒绝原因、人工主干位置、应用与屏幕配置，以及该 action 是否实际执行。finish 应与 evaluator success 分开记录；失败结尾应进入 audit partition，而不是被静默删除。

对 benchmark 研究而言，WindowsAgentArena-V2 是评测面，不是训练 verifier。研究者可以检查 VM reset 可靠性、任务可行性、evaluator false positive/false negative、fail hacking 与 step-cap 敏感性。30 步到 50 步的回退提供了具体终止测试；OSWorld 可用于研究 distribution shift，但必须单独报告不可行任务处理。

复用等级：论文与代码适合阅读、审计和受控复现；由于 screenshot 权利与隐私、逐记录 lineage、合成 action 正确性和不可变版本尚未解决，公开数据对于不受限制的训练复用属于 blocked pending verification。评测复用应固定 benchmark commit、VM/应用版本、任务与 evaluator 文件、分辨率和 step cap。报告的 benchmark 提升可以说明这些实验值得开展，但不是底层数据普遍高质量的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the counting units separate: 312 executed human episodes contain 4,503 screenshots and are flattened, after nine-way branching, into about 27K action-level SFT samples.
  • Read Sections 3.2–3.5 with postprocess/refinement.py, boost.py, and prepare.py; this is where finish rewriting, unexecuted branches, and sample serialization become visible.
  • Interpret Table 3's 141% only as 14.9→36.0 relative to Qwen2.5-VL-72B on 141 feasible WindowsAgentArena-V2 tasks at the default 30-step cap—not as a gain over Claude or a data-quality certificate.
  • Pair Figure 7's human-only and direct-distillation ablations with Appendix E, Table 8: branch augmentation helps in the reported setting, yet longer interaction exposes weak termination behavior.
  • Before reuse, verify screenshot consent and rights, per-record task lineage, Claude decoding and rejection logs, branch executability, semantic decontamination code, and immutable data/benchmark versions.

• 必须区分计数单位：312 条已执行人工 episode 包含 4,503 张 screenshot，经九路分支和展平后形成约 27K 条 action-level SFT 样本。
  • 建议把论文 §3.2–§3.5 与 postprocess/refinement.py、boost.py、prepare.py 对读；finish 重写、未执行分支和样本序列化都在这些位置显现。
  • Table 3 的 141% 只表示在 141 项可行 WindowsAgentArena-V2 任务、默认 30-step cap 下，相对 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 从 14.9 到 36.0；不能解释为相对 Claude 的提升或数据质量证明。
  • 应把 Figure 7 的仅人工与 direct-distillation ablation 同 Appendix E 的 Table 8 一起读：分支增强在报告设置中有帮助，但更长交互暴露出脆弱的终止行为。
  • 复用前仍需核验 screenshot consent 与权利、逐记录任务 lineage、Claude 解码与拒绝日志、分支可执行性、语义 decontamination 代码，以及不可变的数据与 benchmark 版本。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Claude boost branches are never executed and can be plausible but invalid actions.
finish in training data is partly rule-constructed and is not an independent proof of goal completion.
WindowsAgentArena evaluators can contain bugs or reward unintended state changes; the paper reports correcting such cases.
At 50 steps, weak termination awareness causes agents to continue acting and undo completed work.
OSWorld infeasible tasks can reward indiscriminate fail actions.
Claude boost 分支从未执行，可以是看似合理但无效的动作。
